intro: Papua New Guinea covers the eastern half of New Guinea and many islands, with mountains, rainforest and reefs.

chapters.title: Land
text: Mount Wilhelm is the highest peak. The Sepik and Fly are huge rivers. It is home to birds-of-paradise and tree kangaroos, and its reefs are part of the Coral Triangle.

chapters.title: Volcanoes
text: Active volcanoes like Rabaul and Manam erupt from time to time.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Papua New Guinea's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
